marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Capital Expenditure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology companies reported sustained double-digit growth in quarterly capital expenditures dedicated to AI infrastructure and cloud data centers.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained CapEx benefits hardware supply chains and chipmakers, supporting momentum in semiconductor equities across both US and Asian markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of end-user AI software monetization failing to meet elevated market revenue expectations.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & E-Commerce Sector
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed tech platforms accelerated share repurchase programs while reporting cost optimization results in core domestic retail divisions.
marketLayer.inference: Increased shareholder returns via buybacks provide valuation support for the Hang Seng Tech Index amid subdued broader consumer spending.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Price competition in food delivery and local services eroding operating margins.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: US labor market and inflation indicators showed steady moderation, keeping market consensus aligned toward potential policy easing later in the year.
marketLayer.inference: Lower Treasury yields ease valuation pressure on growth stocks and support cross-border capital inflows into Asia-Pacific equity markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky service sector inflation delaying the timing or scale of benchmark interest rate reductions.
